# Chat relay

## Prerequisites

- [Bun](https://bun.sh) installed
- [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) for the Python helpers
- A Tauri app (see https://v2.tauri.app/)

**Never** ask the user to run commands in their terminal that you can run yourself.
Do not ask the user to paste a shell command into the chat; run it yourself.
